# RootFlav

> RootFlav sells high-quality, sun-dried Malabar black pepper sourced directly from farmers in South Kerala, India. Available for retail, wholesale and export customers.

## Key facts
- Product: Malabar black pepper (Piper nigrum), sun-dried
- Origin: South Kerala, India, sourced directly from farmers
- Pack sizes: 75 g, 150 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg
- Customers: households, restaurants, retailers, food businesses, importers and distributors
- Email: info@rootflav.com
- Phone: +91 80890 36639
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rootflav/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/rootflav/
